item.title: Torchy's Tacos soon to close
item.description: Winter Garden's Torchy's Tacos will open its doors to the public for the last time Tuesday, Feb. 3.

item.title: South Philly Steaks to celebrate grand opening in Winter Garden
item.description: The store will open 10 a.m. Friday, Jan. 30, at 3848 Tilden Road, Suite 178, Winter Garden, for its grand-opening celebration.

item.title: Filigree Coffee opens new location
item.description: The coffee shop now is open at 16016 New Independence Pkwy., Suite 110, Winter Garden.

item.title: BREAKING: Police: Summerport shooting victim sustains life-threatening injuries
item.description: Several roads are blocked, and residents have been told to shelter in their homes as police continue to investigate.

item.title: BREAKING: Suspect in Summerport shooting identified
item.description: Orange County Sheriff’s Office deputies discovered Richard Stoner, 67, deceased inside his home at 14255 Sonco Ave., Windermere.

item.title: Former Oakland Avenue Charter teacher to perform at Oakland Heritage Day
item.description: Kyle Zavada was an Oakland Avenue Charter School music teacher for eight years. This week, he is performing as the opening act at Oakland Heritage Day for the second year.

item.title: Matt's Mission installs new AED at Veterans Memorial Park
item.description: This is the fourth AED Matt's Mission has installed in Winter Garden.

item.title: Crossline Community Church's construction soon to begin
item.description: The project, which includes a church, preschool, gym and athletic fields, should be completed in 2027 or 2028.

item.title: Ocoee Police Department reminds residents of RV code requirements
item.description: Recreational Vehicles must not be parked in front lawns for more than 24 hours.

item.title: Winter Garden moves forward with Old Packing House plan
item.description: The Winter Garden City Commission approved a site plan for the Old Packing House that will include restaurants, retail and office space.
